integrity: The displayed identities are proved by direct algebra and a Bernoulli strong-law argument. The finite checker supplements but does not certify asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: The nonidentity Lipschitz and maximum-displacement constants grow with m; no conclusion under uniform almost-sure geometric bounds. Published positivity and rotation-interval theorems are used; independent priority validation is outstanding.
title: Fixed-width random rotation intervals with vanishing topological entropy
